notes.title: Chess Infinity | March Major Update Now Live
notes.content:
A new Major Update is now available for Chess Infinity on all platforms. 

If you haven't already, now is a great time to try our latest Chess title! 

[b]<<<[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2828420/?utm_source=ChessUltraCrossPromotion&utm_campaign=MarchUpdateBlog]Chess Infinity Store Page[/url]>>>[/b]

The update addresses a number of known issues with the base game. Be sure to update before you next play for the best possible experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28735158/347e7bcc8dfbef410ba128a59bb73b06c5e94362.gif[/img]

[h2]Update Features[/h2]

[h3]QoL Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lighting improvements: across all in-game environments, particularly attention paid to darker environments.
[*] Chess set readability: improvement readability across various environments and times of day.
[*] Level loading screens now match the environment you choose.
[*] Added an additional camera option to enable focus on pieces.
[*] Adjustment to the game rating system to better reflect your actual performance in each game.
[*] New intro cameras for the environments.
[*] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28735158/356c327cd9757859772bb4a1e0ac1b294fcb6e0d.gif[/img]

[h3]Bug Fixes
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes to the dynamic weather to stop it raining more than it should.
[*] Fixed an issue with favourited chess sets so that it retains its place in the list.
[*] Fixed an issue with a glitched butterfly stuck in mid air in the Japanese environment.
[*] Fixes where sometimes the player could lose input focus.
[*] Fixed an issue where VFX audio may still play even when VFX is turned off.
[*] Fixed a rare bug that caused the game to occasionally lock on checkmate.
[*] Fixed a rare bug that caused pieces to levitate in lessons.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28735158/27ede88d2480117db4941c33995b0c959dd021a5.gif[/img]

[h3]Performance Optimisations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various audio improvements.
[*] Ray tracing now enabled and set as default (PC only).
[/list]

[previewyoutube=Ywb3SywodX8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]PS5 Pro Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced 'Performance' and 'Fidelity' modes for PS5 Pro - both modes offering ray tracing and optimising either frame rate or resolution.
[*] Note: ray tracing is enabled by default on PS5 Pro ONLY.
[/list]

See you at the board! 
The Ripstone Team

notes.title: Chess Infinity - Out Now On Steam!
notes.content:
[i]Chess lovers, newcomers, strategists, and grandmasters in the making; your next chess experience awaits![/i]

We’re thrilled to introduce [i]Chess Infinity[/i], the recently released spiritual successor to [i]Chess Ultra[/i]. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2828420/Chess_Infinity/
?utm_campaign=CrossPromotionChessUltra
&utm_medium=SteamCommunity
&utm_source=Steam
&utm_content=Event]🛒 Visit the [i]Chess Infinity[/i] Store Page[/url]

Whether you want to refine your strategy, enjoy chess in breathtaking environments, or test your skills against global players, Chess Infinity is built to take you on a journey of mastery, connection, and endless strategy.

[h2]🎨 Immerse Yourself in Breathtaking Environments[/h2]
From sunlit terraces to snow-dusted courtyards, with stunning, handcrafted chess sets that bring the beauty of the game to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28735158/4fd755d6bb1a78674020d18d08bfdd9549a7d0d8.jpg[/img]

[h2]🧠 Learn and Improve[/h2] 
Hone your skills and develop new strategies with the help of Aion, an adaptive chess mentor designed by grandmasters. Take interactive tutorials and benefit from optional in-game tactical overlays that provide move-by-move analysis to help you sharpen your play at every level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28735158/d57f9315000f22b203501561806f5539f1abaf10.jpg[/img]

[h2]🌍 Compete Anytime, Anywhere[/h2]
Chess Infinity features seamless cross-platform multiplayer and a refined Elo system to ensure every opponent is a worthy challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28735158/6d9d0049b78374304c29b661ea7e223f332be075.jpg[/img]

[h2]🏆 Progress and Personalise[/h2] 
Tailor your Chess Infinity experience to your liking with unlockable chess sets and multiple playing locations. 

Progress through 90 handcrafted puzzle challenges, and a learning-focused Journey that encourages the discovery of new tactics and genuine strategic growth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28735158/41b5dc159021763a9f10e4f1da899ab3bd47491c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Your Next Move Awaits[/h3]
If you’ve enjoyed Chess Ultra, we think you'll love Chess Infinity. 

Whether you seek deep strategic play, rewarding progression, or a beautifully immersive chess experience, this is the evolution of digital chess.

The board is set. It’s time to make your move.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2828420/Chess_Infinity/
?utm_campaign=CrossPromotionChessUltra
&utm_medium=SteamCommunity
&utm_source=Steam
&utm_content=Event]🕊️ Step into [i]Chess Infinity[/i] today.[/url]

notes.title: Introducing Cross-play with Epic Games
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28735158/29672bfde97b54d5cd31e8957704f0f64b1c4ead.png[/img]

We’re pleased to announce that additional cross-play features for Chess Ultra have arrived in a new update! 

Chess Ultra players on Steam can now play seamlessly with friends on Epic Games. You can also choose which friends list to play with and, for multiplayer matchmaking, you’ll find a larger pool of players to connect with across both Steam and Epic Games.

This update also includes performance and optimisation improvements, as well as a fix for a recently reported issue that was impacting players with Intel 11th Gen (and up) CPUs running Windows 11. 

Please note: as a result of the update, there may be some downtime for Chess Ultra’s online multiplayer until around 8 PM GMT today. 

We hope you enjoy it, and thanks as always for your support!

notes.title: Quality Of Life Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28735158/243a80cffb38b8b0662b63175bec22146d1b51d0.png[/img]


Hi everyone,

A brand new update is now available for Chess Ultra. We’ve been listening to your feedback and making some changes that we hope will cover what a lot of you have been asking for. Here’s what you’ll find in the update:

[list]
[*] We’ve slowed down the camera’s rotation speed and it’s now harder to accidentally unlock, making it easier to find and keep it in that sweet spot.
[*] Twitch integration is back! Challenge chat to a one vs everyone game and get your community involved in your chess streams.
[*] We’ve reduced the time taken to time out in a community tournament. We’re hoping that this will help to speed them up and ensure that you aren’t waiting too long for your next game. We’d love to hear your feedback on this and if you feel that it’s now where it needs to be so that we can adjust it further if it’s needed.
[*] With the addition of some more backend tools, there will be brand new community tournaments on the way, so keep your eyes peeled.
[*] Blitz mode animations are now much faster.
[*] We’ve removed the online requirement to play on PC.
[/list]


Thanks as always for your support,

Team Ripstone

notes.title: Take a trip to Santa Monica Chess Park
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/3e1df383624e692bf16e616836ceecb73a3d52c7.png[/img]

Ever wanted to play chess at the beach without going outside? Then this is the DLC pack for you...

We're super excited to share the brand new Santa Monica Pack for Chess Ultra, which launched this week and is playable both with and without VR. The pack contains an environment and a chess set, bringing the sandy beaches of Santa Monica to Chess Ultra.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/638011/Chess_Ultra_Santa_Monica_Game_Pack/

The beach environment was modelled on the real life Santa Monica chess park, whilst the chess set was inspired by the skate scene of California. We spent a long time contemplating how the pieces would look in-game and landed on a hand-made style, with each chess piece fashioned from recycled skateboard parts. You can see an early concept that we created during the design process below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/9273884e6e7fdeebd38416de5fd55c4586cd6416.jpg[/img]

We hope you like the contemporary style of the new set and enjoy playing in the California sunshine! The pack is available to purchase now for £4.79.

Thanks as always for your support,

Ripstone

notes.title: Chess Ultra X Purling London Collection - Out Now
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/d669b8b4d0a276ceae4663b6de94a4999eea04a8.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

Two announcements to share with you today; new DLC and details of the next official Ripstone Tournament. (It's starting next week!)

We're delighted to announce our partnership with the critically acclaimed team at Purling London to bring several of their bespoke, hand-painted chess sets to the virtual world of Chess Ultra. The four exclusive sets are available to download in-game now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/e5c892f5f1b62eba61549cb7057fbbc337a08bbf.jpg[/img]

Celebrated international contemporary artists have used the traditional Staunton chess set as an unconventional “canvas” upon which they have created one-of-a-kind, hand-painted works. Purling names this line of their collection “Art Chess” as they create a diverse line artistic gaming sets and four of these designs will be available in Chess Ultra.

We hope you enjoy playing with the sets as much as we enjoyed creating them! 

To celebrate the launch of the Purling London collection, we are hosting a new official Ripstone chess Tournament! The tournament will start in-game on Monday 9th April at 11am BST, so make sure to get in there early to reserve your slot.

Thanks as always for your support.

Ripstone

notes.title: Russian Academy Pack - Available Now
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/3065defc02f5b2b9e93eb6ec303f3c820ebcd7fa.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

We've got an announcement to share that will hopefully brighten your Friday... a brand new DLC Pack is available now for Chess Ultra!

The Academy Pack contains two new pieces of DLC for Chess Ultra and is a tribute to the long and noble chess playing tradition in Russia that has produced some of the greatest players of all time.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/638980/Chess_Ultra_Academy_game_pack/

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/25595a4277558670e0ef089020a53e0733488bad.png[/img]

The Akademiya environment invites you to follow in the footsteps of the Russian Grandmasters that played in the halls of the academy, and is fully playable in VR. We invite you to immerse yourself in the tournament setting and feel the pressure with every move.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/c8f7c2a6f64d0bc1f9d79c02094ad5d4d7422145.png[/img]

The Academy Pack also contains the simple yet beautiful Kholmogory chess set, which is available in two materials; traditional wood and sleek plastic. The design was modelled on a rare chess set created in the Russian town of Kholmogory, and pays homage to the rich chess history held by the rural village.

The pack is available to download now for £4.79 / $5.99. We're really excited to be sharing this new content with you and hope you enjoy playing using the new environment and chess set!

Thanks for your ongoing support,

Ripstone

notes.title: Free DLC for the Holidays - Available Now
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/2b83035261899660752a3157bafb222590b2ee25.png[/img]

The Ripstone holiday elves have been working extra hard this year and have prepared a special Christmas gift for you all to enjoy…

As a special festive treat for fans of Chess Ultra, we launched the Easter Island chess set today, for free! The Easter Island chess set is inspired by the mysterious Moai of Easter Island, Polynesia. These head-like, monolithic chess pieces have been beautifully crafted, bringing the Moai not only to life – but to the chess board. The set comes with two material variants; rock and metal, and can be played in any environment within Chess Ultra.

You can download the free DLC using the link below, and we really hope you enjoy taking to the board with a brand new set.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/639000/Chess_Ultra_Easter_Island_chess_set/

Thank you as always for your support and we hope you enjoy the holiday season!

Ripstone

notes.title: Imperial DLC Out Now - Fit For a King
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/0757041c16e0c1bff9f5ee128b577224c6741d28.png[/img]

A brand new DLC chess set launched today!

The Imperial pack for Chess Ultra contains two exquisite chessmen designs, and brings a touch of luxury to the chessboard.

The Ruby and Emerald set radiates elegance with polished gold adorned with the finest gemstones, whilst the Platinum and Onyx set provides a striking contrast with stylish gunmetal pieces and elegant stones to match. Both chess set designs have been hand-crafted and embellished with jewels fit for a King or Queen.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/639001/Chess_Ultra_Imperial_chess_set/

We’re really excited to be bringing another new chess set to Chess Ultra, especially as this design is very different to any of the styles we have worked on previously! We hope the Imperial pack brings you luck on the chessboard and we will have more details to share about upcoming releases for Chess Ultra soon, so watch this space.

Thanks as always for your support,

Team Ripstone

notes.title: Ripstone Autumn Tournament
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/cdad9100bd2174113be0d9ee2f214af5a9108389.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

We want to share a quick update to let you know that the Official Ripstone Autumn Tournament will start tomorrow, 29th September, at 10am BST. We're really looking forward to launching the second official tournament as there were some incredibly impressive games played during the first competition. 

We made some changes to the way tournaments work during the Summer leg, so we're confident that the Autumn Tournament will run a lot more smoothly! There is a 72 hour (3 day) limit for making a move when playing a tournament game, which will help to keep things moving and advance players through each round more efficiently. We also removed the in game timer to make way for this 72 hour time limit, so make sure to return to your game with plenty of time!

Get ready to bring your A-game and battle for the top spot.

Good luck everyone!

notes.title: Update 3 Arrives Today + DLC is Coming!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/1f7186a36fc736d7eb61351859dff37db09a2dcb.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

A new update is now available which makes a few changes as outlined below:

• Added a popup showing Elo changes to the game-over sequence
• Fixed tournament achievements not always unlocking correctly
• Fixed the 'piece' camera mode not being movable during the opponent's turn
• Fixed non-timed tournaments always showing 0 time remaining
• Other minor bug fixes

We're always looking for ways to improve Chess Ultra so thank you to everyone that has provided feedback so far! We are incredibly grateful for your ongoing support.

We also have some exciting news to share...

DLC is coming to Chess Ultra! 

You can get an exclusive first look at one of the new environments above and we can't wait to share more details with you in the coming weeks. Also, let us know what sort of DLC you would like to see, if there is a specific chess set you would like to play with in-game or any environments you would like to visit in VR!

Thanks as always for your support,

Team Ripstone

notes.title: Update 2 Available Now: Style Changes and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/29672bfde97b54d5cd31e8957704f0f64b1c4ead.png[/img]Hey everyone,

Thanks for your patience with our second update to Chess Ultra. We really value your feedback and support so we're really happy to share this latest update with you that includes a variety of style changes and a few bug fixes...

- Cross-platform matchmaking made easier
A search feature has been added so you should be able to find your friends easier when playing on different platforms. If you have friends playing on other platforms they won't be able to use this feature yet but it will be going into the update we do on console in the near future. 

- Free camera option
We know some of you wanted to be able to explore different camera angles to view the board and the beautiful locations you're playing chess in. The angles you can move the camera to have been expanded and the camera can be locked in place. 

- Single Tournament 'No Timer' option added
There's now a 'no timer' option for tournaments, nothing much else to say here!

- New end game camera
There's now an all new cinematic end game camera. It also tells you why stalemates happened, and differentiates between winning by checkmate, resignation, or time forfeit.

-  Indicators to show whether a player is online or not
This will show you whether a player was active online in the game within the last few minutes.

- Offering a Draw
This was missing from the menu UI, but it is now there so you can draw by agreement. However, if you are playing cross-platform, you won't be able to offer a draw against someone on console until the update has gone live for them.

- What are the controls?
Some of you were unsure of what the controls were in the game, so we have added this to the menu to make it clear for everyone. 

- Missing tutorial text
Some of it decided to hide, it has now been found and is no longer missing.

There's been some other minor general fixes too. As always if you have any feedback please let us know on the Discussions page or email us on info@ripstone.com 

Thanks again for your ongoing support!

Team Ripstone

notes.title: Update: Bug fixes and Tournament Rule Changes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28735158/44026bce69f0fa15112750aeefeba1e98f265f08.png[/img]Hey everyone,

First things first..  the whole team here at Ripstone would like to say a huge thank you to everyone that has been in touch with us since Chess Ultra launched. Your support has been amazing and we’re incredibly grateful for your feedback. We want to make Chess Ultra the best it can be, and with your support we’re confident that we’re well on our way to doing just that!

This morning we launched the first update for Chess Ultra, which addresses a couple of reported issues and also made some changes to the way tournaments play out. Here are the update details in full:

- Amended end game camera
We’ve slowed down the end game camera to make celebrating a win (or crying over a loss) that little bit easier on the eyes.

- HUD timer 
There is now a timer built in to the HUD for every game played using a time control. 

- Missing Tutorial Text/Missing Localisation
All tutorial text will now be visible! Fixed an issue that was causing text to disappear for certain users. We have also added in the two missing Russian/Dutch messages from the tutorials too.

- Sneaky ELO comma
A wild comma found its way into the main menu as part of the ELO ranking display. It has now been banished.

- The Ripstone phone is on silent
The vibrating phone in Mulholland has been silenced, so no more buzzing.

- Official Tournament capacity display
The capacity of the official Ripstone tournament will now be displayed in the tournament menu, so it is clear to see when a vacant slot is available.

- White AI bug
Fixed an issue that was causing the AI to play repetitive opening moves when playing as white.

- Tournament Rule Change
There has been a delay to tournament proceedings due to inactivity, so there is now a 72 hour (3 day) limit for making a move when playing a tournament game. This will help to keep things moving and to get through each round more efficiently. We've also removed the in game timer that is currently used in official Ripstone tournaments to make way for this 72 hour time limit. We're confident that this will improve the tournament experience and are looking forward to seeing the Ripstone Summer Tournament start moving again!

A couple of things to be aware of, if you were playing in a tournament and hadn’t made an opening move/had been inactive for over 3 days, your position will now have been forfeited since the update went live earlier today. But this does mean that there may now be some vacant spaces, for anyone that didn’t manage to jump in the first time around!

We’re here to listen to your feedback, so please let us know of any issues on the discussions page, or email us at info@ripstone.com.

Thanks as always,

Team Ripstone

Chess Ultra launches today for PC, HTC Vive and Oculus and we’re super excited to finally share the game with you all. notes.title: Chess Ultra Launch Date + Grim Reaper Reveal
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We can now announce that Chess Ultra will be launching later this month on 21st June!

As well as sharing details of our launch plans, we also just revealed a brand new launch trailer which is available to watch [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FrONtYp6Pic]here[/url] and on the Chess Ultra Store page. 

The trailer not only showcases the stunning 4K environments and sets of Chess Ultra, but introduces the Grim Reaper, who players can meet face to face in VR. Virtual Reality players can challenge Death in the pits of Gomorrah, their mortal soul in the balance. Play well and he’ll get angry; his eyes burn with rage and the lava will flow ferociously. But lose, and he’ll reach over and take your soul.

We're hosting a developer stream tomorrow on [url=twith.tv/ripstonegames]Twitch[/url] from 4pm BST to discuss the announcement and to answer any questions you may have, so hope to see some of you there.

Check you later! (sorry for the bad joke)

Ripstone

notes.title: Chess Ultra Checks in on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're incredibly excited to be bringing you the first update about our latest game Chess Ultra! 

Bringing together community feedback, stunning 4K visuals and seamless VR compatibility, Chess Ultra is online chess like you've never seen before. Developed internally by the development team here at Ripstone, we have spent a lot of time curating the perfect chess experience and we can't wait for you to start making your moves in game.

Chess Ultra includes a range of features that cater to all abilities and skill levels, from beginner tutorials right through to Grandmaster challenges, an online tournament mode, Twitch integration and a variety of time control options. We also worked closely with a team of Grandmasters during development to ensure continuity and accurate AI levelling, so get ready to bring your A game!

Watch this space for more updates in regard to the launch date and pricing, and make sure to [url=twitch.tv/ripstonegames]catch us on Twitch[/url] every Monday at 4pm BST for developer streams and exclusive feature showcases. You can now add Chess Ultra to your wishlist to be notified when the game launches, and if you have any questions, please drop us a message in the community hub and we'll get back to you as soon as we can!

Team Ripstone
